messages:
Maria P.: Heads-up — NimbusCloud asked for a Marketplace-ready onboarding bundle: Terraform modules + reference architecture docs + a tiny sample app to validate deploys. We need clear owners for: module template (multi-arch), CI (lint/tfsec/terratest), refarch writeup, and a sample app integration test.

Alex W.: I can own the module template and compatibility matrix. Will focus on arm64 + x86 build artifacts. :thumbsup:

Jin L.: I’ll take CI. Plan is GH Actions: fmt, init/plan, tfsec, then terratest in matrix. Will add a workflow stub below.

Jin L.: ```yaml
name: terraform-ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tf_version: [1.3.9, 1.4.6]
        arch: [x86, arm64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ matrix.tf_version }}
      - name: terraform fmt -check
        run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
      - name: tfsec scan
        run: tfsec .
      - name: run terratest
        run: go test -v ./test || true
```

Sam K.: Quick note — refarch needs to call out network/topology for Marketplace (VPC peering, NAT, subnet sizing) and runtime sizing for inference (batching vs low-latency). Also include a small cost example.

Maria P.: Agree. For sample app, keep it minimal: dockerized app + TF to provision infra + smoke test that hits model endpoint. I’ll draft the refarch doc skeleton and link it.

Maria P.: https://internal.docs/redwood/partner-onboard/nimbus-stub — (draft) section list: overview, architecture diagram, terraform usage, CI badge, rollout checklist. :eyes:

Alex W.: Will create module repo under org: redwood/marketplace-nimbus-module and seed it with README + example. I’ll also add provider aliasing and outputs for the registry.
